title: Panoramax
description: Metrics of a Panoramax instance from osm-fulda/panoramax-exporter.

list.name: job
list.label: Job
list.description: Prometheus job that scrapes the exporter.

list.name: instance
list.label: Instance
list.description: The Panoramax instance, as labelled by your scrape config.

panels.title: About this dashboard
panels.description: How to read this dashboard: data source, what the variables select and why some panels need an admin token.

options.content:
Metrics from [panoramax-exporter](https://github.com/osm-fulda/panoramax-exporter) for one Panoramax instance, picked with the **job** and **instance** variables above.

The exporter refreshes every `REFRESH_INTERVAL` (default 5 min), so a curve moves in steps no matter how often Prometheus scrapes. **Public catalogue** panels need no credentials and count *public* data only. **Instance** and **Moderation** panels need `PANORAMAX_TOKEN` (Panoramax ≥ 2.15.1); without it they read *needs admin token* instead of a number.

panels.title: Scrape target
panels.description:
Whether Prometheus reached the exporter's `/metrics` at its last scrape (Prometheus' own `up` series for this target).

**Means:** *failing* = the exporter is down, unreachable or rejects the scrape (e.g. wrong basic-auth). Every other panel then shows the last values Prometheus had.

panels.title: Panoramax API
panels.description:
`panoramax_up`: whether the exporter's last refresh of the public STAC API (`/api/collections`) succeeded.

**Means:** *failing* = the exporter runs but cannot read the instance (instance down, network, or a changed API). The catalogue numbers are then stale.

panels.title: Data age
panels.description:
Time since the exporter last refreshed successfully (`time() - panoramax_scrape_timestamp_seconds`).

**Means:** it should stay below about two `REFRESH_INTERVAL`s (default 5 min). Yellow from 15 min, red from 30 min: the refresh loop is stuck or keeps failing, and the numbers here are out of date.

panels.title: Refresh duration
panels.description:
`panoramax_scrape_duration_seconds`: how long the last walk over the public catalogue took.

**Means:** it grows with the number of sequences. A jump without growth points at a slow instance; close to `REFRESH_INTERVAL` means refreshes start to overlap the interval.

panels.title: Admin stats
panels.description:
`panoramax_admin_stats_up`: whether the last read of `/api/admin/stats` succeeded.

**Means:** *off / failing* = either no `PANORAMAX_TOKEN` is set (expected, the Instance panels then stay empty) or the token is rejected or the instance is older than 2.15.1.

panels.title: Reports
panels.description:
`panoramax_reports_up`: whether the last read of `/api/admin/reports/stats` succeeded. Fetched independently of the admin stats, so one can fail while the other works.

**Means:** *off / failing* = no token, a token without reviewer rights, or the endpoint failed; the Moderation panels then stay empty.

panels.title: Sequences
panels.description:
`panoramax_sequences_total`: public sequences (STAC collections).

**Means:** a drop = sequences were deleted or made non-public.

panels.title: Pictures
panels.description:
`panoramax_pictures_total`: pictures in public sequences.

**Means:** compare with *All pictures* under Instance; the gap is non-public data.

panels.title: Length
panels.description:
`panoramax_length_km_total`: summed length of all public sequences.

**Means:** the street coverage the instance offers publicly.

panels.title: Contributors
panels.description:
`panoramax_contributors_total`: distinct accounts owning at least one public sequence.

**Means:** not the number of accounts (see *Accounts* under Instance), only those who published.

panels.title: Pictures over time
panels.description:
`panoramax_pictures_total` over the selected range.

**Means:** steps up = uploads went public; a step down = deletions or sequences hidden.

panels.title: Length over time
panels.description:
`panoramax_length_km_total` over the selected range.

**Means:** how fast public coverage grows.

panels.title: Sequences and contributors
panels.description:
`panoramax_sequences_total` and `panoramax_contributors_total` over the selected range.

**Means:** new contributors show up here first; many sequences from few people is normal for a small instance.

panels.title: Per contributor
panels.description:
`panoramax_user_pictures_total`, `panoramax_user_sequences_total` and `panoramax_user_length_km_total`, current values, one row per account that owns public sequences.

**Means:** empty while the exporter runs with `PER_USER=false`. Account names are public on the instance anyway; this repeats them.

panels.title: Pictures per contributor
panels.description:
`panoramax_user_pictures_total` for the ten largest contributors.

**Means:** who drives the growth seen above. Empty with `PER_USER=false`.

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: `panoramax_accounts_total`: registered accounts, whether or not they ever uploaded.

panels.title: All pictures
panels.description: `panoramax_pictures_all_total`: every picture the instance holds, including non-public ones.

panels.title: All sequences
panels.description: `panoramax_sequences_all_total`: every sequence, including non-public ones.

panels.title: Non-public pictures
panels.description:
`panoramax_pictures_all_total - panoramax_pictures_total`: pictures that exist but are not in the public catalogue (hidden, still processing, broken).

**Means:** growing steadily = pictures get stuck before they become public; check *Pictures by status*.

targets.expr: (panoramax_pictures_all_total{job="$job", instance="$instance"} - on(job, instance) panoramax_pictures_total{job="$job", instance="$instance"}) and on() (panoramax_admin_stats_up{job="$job", instance="$instance"} == 1)

panels.title: Last upload
panels.description:
`panoramax_last_picture_inserted_seconds`: time since the most recent picture was inserted.

**Means:** large = nobody uploads, or uploads fail before insert. Empty on an instance without pictures.

panels.title: Oldest due job
panels.description:
`panoramax_job_queue_oldest_seconds`: age of the oldest job currently due; 0 when none is due (the exporter reports that as `NaN`).

**Means:** 0 is the normal idle state. Minutes are normal after an upload; hours = workers are stuck or far behind.

targets.expr: (panoramax_job_queue_oldest_seconds{job="$job", instance="$instance"} >= 0 or on() vector(0)) and on() (panoramax_admin_stats_up{job="$job", instance="$instance"} == 1)

panels.title: New accounts
panels.description:
`panoramax_accounts_new_total` per window (1d / 7d / 30d, fixed by the API).

**Means:** a sudden jump in 1d without a matching event can be spam sign-ups.

panels.title: New pictures
panels.description:
`panoramax_pictures_new_total` per window (1d / 7d / 30d), including non-public ones.

**Means:** upload activity independent of when pictures become public.

panels.title: Sequences by visibility
panels.description:
`panoramax_sequences_by_visibility`: sequences per visibility setting.

**Means:** explains most of the gap between public and all sequences.

panels.title: Pictures by status
panels.description:
`panoramax_pictures_by_status`: pictures per processing status, stacked.

**Means:** a growing `broken` band = processing failures; a growing `waiting-for-process` band = the workers do not keep up.

panels.title: Sequences by status
panels.description:
`panoramax_sequences_by_status`: sequences per status, stacked.

**Means:** sequences that stay in a non-ready status point at the same processing problems as above.

panels.title: Job queue
panels.description:
`panoramax_job_queue_depth`: pending jobs per task, stacked. The age of the oldest due job is the *Oldest due job* panel above.

**Means:** `prepare` climbing and not draining = ingest backlog.

panels.title: Open reports
panels.description:
`panoramax_reports_open_total`: reports still unresolved (`open`, `open_autofix`, `waiting`).

**Means:** this is the moderation backlog; it should not grow for long. Privacy and blur reports usually want attention first, see the panel next to it.

panels.title: Reports by status
panels.description:
`panoramax_reports_by_status_total`: all reports ever filed, per status.

**Means:** mostly `closed_*` on a well-moderated instance.

panels.title: Unresolved reports by issue
panels.description:
`panoramax_reports_total` summed over the unresolved statuses (`open`, `open_autofix`, `waiting`), per issue type.

**Means:** what the backlog consists of. `privacy` and `blur_missing` concern personal data.

targets.expr: sum by (issue) (panoramax_reports_total{job="$job", instance="$instance", status=~"open|open_autofix|waiting"}) and on() (panoramax_reports_up{job="$job", instance="$instance"} == 1)

panels.title: Open reports over time
panels.description:
`panoramax_reports_open_total` over the selected range.

**Means:** a curve that only rises = reports arrive faster than they are handled.
